title: Teal Bandhani Chiffon Anarkali Gown with Shimmer Belt
color_custom: Teal blue with white bandhani print
description:
Saanvi is a name of Goddess Lakshmi – a flowing teal bandhani gown for celebrations.

Teal chiffon, the classic bandhani pattern of Rajasthan and a skirt that opens into a full circle when you turn. This floor-length Anarkali gown is finished with sheer puff sleeves and a matching belt lined with shimmer lace that sits right at the waist. Light enough to dance in all night, polished enough for a wedding.

✦ The Details
• Floor-length Anarkali gown with a full flared hem
• Square neckline in front, deep square back with a tie-up dori and tassels
• Sheer full-length puff sleeves with soft elastic cuffs
• Matching belt with shimmer lace, ties at the back
• Bandhani print all over
• 2 pieces: gown and belt

✦ Fabric & Craft
The gown is airy chiffon with a soft Kota lining inside, so it flows and twirls but is never see-through. The belt is finished with Kota lace for a gentle shimmer. Made in our own unit in Jaipur.

✦ Fit & Size
Fitted through the bodice with a full flare below the belt. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up, and message us on WhatsApp for help.

✦ How to Style It
Silver jhumkas or statement oxidised studs, a bindi and metallic block heels. For a sangeet or mehndi, add a silver potli bag. Abroad in winter, a long white or camel coat looks lovely over teal.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur, with photos of your piece before it ships
• Free shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, duties prepaid, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Dry clean recommended. Do not wring. Store folded or on a padded hanger.
